sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews: an instrument's window now shows MusicBrainz's own IROMBOOK drawing of it (no extra request) and its links, as majkinetor's Event Horizon does; a series' window shows its own picture link, else the image its Wikidata item names (asked on Space only), and its links. The card shows the picture once a window found it. A place's or a series' own page now shows the picture its preview window found (Wikidata's too) beside the name, from this browser's storage, without asking anything.
